profile_text.body:
Cartesia is a for-profit startup founded in 2023 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. Its site describes the company as building AI that learns and interacts like humans, and its commercial offering is real-time text-to-speech: a streaming TTS API built around Sonic-3.6, which the company says generates natural, expressive voices, including laughter, in 44 languages and is aimed at AI agents and interactive applications.

The company states that its team has pioneered AI architectures including state space models (SSMs), Mamba and H-Nets, and frames that research as the realization of its mission to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world as humans do. Its profile lists no lawsuits involving the company.
